limits: This is an exploratory manual browser run against an already running local demo. Its process commit could not be verified, so it is not evidence for final-HEAD browser acceptance.
No browser-side timing instrumentation was captured; do not infer first-token latency or claim that model tokens stream before response validation.
The snapshot is dated 2026-09-15 and does not establish current in-store price or availability.
This run covers one Vietnamese session and three turns only; it is not blind, human-reviewed, concurrent-load, voice, or production evaluation.
